description: This file defines the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which specifies methods for initializing, retrieving messages, handling message delivery notifications, and shutting down a queue adapter receiver in a streaming context.

classes.name: IQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Interface for receiving message batches from a message queue partition, with methods for initialization, retrieving messages, confirming delivery, and shutdown.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver with a given timeout.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves up to maxCount message batches asynchronously from the queue.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Notifies that the specified message batches have been delivered.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down and cleans up the receiver within the specified timeout.
